title: Spatial analysis of organ-wide RNA, protein expression, and lineage tracing in the female mouse reproductive tract
protocol: Euthanize the experimental mice according to the ethically approved technique.
Fix the mice to the dissection platform with the ventral side facing up and pin the legs with wall needles.
Sterilize the entire surface of the mouse with 70% ethanol.
Lift the skin of the abdomen and abdominal muscles with a pair of forceps.
Make a small cut giving an incision extending down to the genital opening.
Give transverse incisions along the length of the limbs.
Pin down the separated skin and the muscular folding to the dissection platform.
Carefully remove the entire female mouse reproductive tract (FRT) from the abdominal cavity.
Place the FRT tissue in a Petri dish and clear off any adipose and connective tissue surrounding the FRT.
Transfer the tissue to a Falcon tube and wash tissue with PBS by inverting the tube several times.
Discard the PFA, wash tissue thrice with 10 mL sterile PBS.
Tissue used for IHC can be stored in PBS at 4°C for 1 week until the next step.
The tissue used for smRNA-ISH should be processed immediately for the next step.
Place the tissue between sponges inside the embedding cassette.
Label the cassette with a pencil.
Place the labeled cassette inside the processing chamber of the tissue processor.
Immerse the tissue in 50% ethanol for 1 hour with agitation.
Immerse the tissue in 70% ethanol for 1 hour with agitation.
Immerse the tissue in 90% ethanol for 1 hour with agitation.
Immerse the tissue in 100% ethanol for 1 hour with agitation.
Repeat immersion in 100% ethanol for another 1 hour with agitation.
Immerse the tissue in 100% isopropanol for 1 hour with agitation.
Repeat immersion in 100% isopropanol for another 1 hour with agitation.
Immerse the tissue in Xylene for 1 hour with agitation.
Repeat immersion in Xylene for another 1 hour with agitation.
Embed dehydrated and paraffinized tissue using a paraffin embedding machine.
Place the entire FRT horizontally to ensure the whole tissue is in the same plane before adding the paraffin.
Cool the paraffin block on the cooling pad after embedding.
Remove the paraffin-embedded tissue with cassette from the metal jar using a scalpel blade.
Store paraffinized tissue blocks at 25°C for long-term storage.
Place the paraffinized tissue block on ice for at least 30 minutes before sectioning.
Cut 5–7 μm thick sections for IHC using a microtome.
Cut 10 μm sections for smRNA-ISH using a microtome.
Pour 250 mL of DAKO target retrieval solution into a glass jar and place it in a water bath.
Set the temperature of the water bath to 95°C.
Immerse slides with tissue sections in an oven for 1 hour at 60°C.
Immersed slides through a series of reagents inside a fume hood, moving them up and down at least 5-10 times every 2-3 minutes in each step.
Place the slides in target retrieval solution, close the lid, and incubate for 30 minutes.
Make sure water bath temperature has reached 95°C.
Keep the target retrieval solution with slides for 20 min at 25°C after boiling.
Remove the slides and wash 5 times with tap water by dipping up and down 3 to 4 times per wash.
Draw a circle around the tissue section using a Pap pen or Immedge hydrophobic barrier pen.
Add 50–100 μL of PBS on top of the tissue section to prevent it from drying out.
Remove PBS and add 50–100 μL of IHC blocking solution onto the tissue section.
Incubate for 60 min at 25°C in a moisture chamber (to prevent drying).
Remove IHC blocking solution and add 50–100 μL of primary antibodies diluted in IHC blocking solution.
Incubate for 14 h at 4°C in a moisture chamber, ensuring the tissue section is completely covered with antibody solution.
Wash the tissue section 5 times with PBS for 2–5 min at 25°C each time.
Add 50–100 μL of fluorochrome-linked secondary antibodies diluted in IHC blocking solution and DNA dye (e.g., Draq5, Hoechst).
Incubate for 60 min at 25°C in a moisture chamber in the dark.
Wash the tissue section 5 times with PBS for 2–5 min at 25°C each time.
Wash the tissue section once with distilled water.
Remove excess water with tissue paper without touching the tissue region or allowing it to dry.
Add 3 to 4 drops of Mowiol on top of the tissue section.
Place a coverslip above and gently squeeze out excess Mowiol using bent forceps.
Keep the slides for 14 h at 25°C in a dark place.
Pause the experiment and store the solution at 4°C in the dark until fluorescence microscopy is performed.
Add 50-100 μL of IHC blocking solution onto the tissue section for staining purposes.
Incubate the tissue section with IHC blocking solution for 60 min at 25°C in a moisture chamber in the dark.
Remove the IHC blocking solution and add directly tagged primary antibody diluted in IHC blocking solution along with DNA dye (e.g., Draq5 or Hoechst) onto the tissue section.
Inject 50 μL of tamoxifen solution per mouse intraperitoneally.
Wipe the abdominal surface with 70% ethanol before injection.
Repeat the injection 2 times on consecutive days.
Observe the health of the mice daily.
Euthanize mice according to standard ethically approved procedure between 1 week and 20 weeks post-tamoxifen injection.
Isolate FRT following steps 1–7.
Proceed for sectioning (steps 50–57, steps 58–62).
Detect lineage traced cells directly (steps 47–49) or by co-immunohistochemistry according to the procedure below steps 58–65.
Dilute choice of DNA Dye in permeabilization buffer (1:1000 for Draq5, 1:2000 for Hoechst).
Add 100 μL per tissue section and incubate for 30 min at 25°C.
Visualize the lineage traced cells by standard microscopic methods.
Isolate FRT tissue.
Place the isolated FRT tissue in 10 mL of 2% PFA solution in a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Incubate the tissue with 2% PFA for 1 hour at 25°C in a dark place.
Remove the PFA from the tissue and wash it three times with 1× PBS.
Prepare the freezing apparatus inside a fume hood.
Fill an icebox one-fourth full with dry ice.
Add an equal volume of isopropanol to the icebox.
Place a small plastic box filled with 5 mL of isopentane on top of isopropanol.
Incubate the plastic box for 15 min to cool down.
Remove tissue from PBS and dry excess liquid using a tissue pad.
Spread OCT medium inside the plastic cryomold.
Place the tissue in the cryomold, add OCT medium until the tissue is completely covered.
Place the cryomold on top of pre-cooled isopentane in the freezing apparatus.
Incubate until OCT medium has hardened.
Store frozen tissue at −80°C for long-term storage.
Cut 5–7 μm thick tissue sections in the cryotome.
Place the tissue sections on SuperFrost Plus adhesion slides.
Air-dry the slides at a dark place and proceed immediately to smRNA-ISH procedure or IHC.
Before starting IHC, keep the slides inside an oven for 20 min at 40°C.
Wash slides 5 times with 1× PBS for 3 min each time.
Using a Pap pen, circle around the tissue section.
Add 50–100 μL of PBS on top of the tissue section to prevent it from drying out.
Remove PBS and add 50–100 μL of permeabilization solution for 1 hour at 25°C.
Incubate the slides 2 times in Xylene for 5 min at 25°C each time.
Incubate the slides 2 times in 100% Ethanol for 1 min at 25°C each time.
Air-dry the slides for at least 5 min at 25°C or until completely dry.
Apply RNAscope Hydrogen Peroxide.
Incubate slides with RNAscope Hydrogen Peroxide for 10 min at 25°C.
Wash slides 2 times in distilled water for 5 min at 25°C each time.
Very slowly submerge the slide rack containing the slides into boiling RNAscope 1× target retrieval reagent solution.
Cover the beaker with aluminum foil and boil the slides for 20 min.
Wash slides 2 times in distilled water for 5 min at 25°C each time.
Wash slides once with fresh 100% EtOH.
Dry the slides completely at 25°C.
Draw a barrier 2 times around each section with the Immedge hydrophobic barrier pen.
Dry slides for 14 hours to use the following day.
Turn on the HybEZ oven and set the temperature to 40°C.
Place a humidifying paper in the humidity control tray and wet thoroughly with distilled water.
Warm the tray for 30 minutes at 40°C before use.
Keep the tray in the oven when not in use.
Do not allow slides to dry between incubation and washing steps.
Remove AMP 1 to 6 reagents from the refrigerator and place them at 25°C.
Apply RNAscope Protease Plus to cover each tissue section entirely.
Place dried slides on the HybEZ slide rack.
Insert tray with slides back into the oven.
Incubate at 40°C for 25 minutes.
Incubate tissue sections with FRT solution for 25 minutes to remove crosslinks and preserve morphology.
Wash slides by immersing them five times in distilled water.
Warm target and control probes for at least 10 minutes at 40°C before use.
Add three drops of the appropriate probe to cover each tissue section entirely.
Cover the HybEZ humidity control tray with a lid and incubate it in an oven at 40°C for 2 hours.
Wash slides two times in 1× wash buffer for 2 minutes at 25°C each time.
Add approximately two to three drops of AMP1 to cover each section entirely.
Close the tray and incubate it in the oven at 40°C for 30 minutes.
Wash slides two times in 1× wash buffer for 2 minutes at 25°C each time.
Add approximately two to three drops of AMP2 to cover each section entirely.
Close the tray and incubate it in the oven at 40°C for 15 minutes.
Wash slides two times in 1× wash buffer for 2 minutes at 25°C each time.
Add approximately two to three drops of AMP3 to cover each section entirely.
Close the tray and incubate it in the oven at 40°C for 30 minutes.
Wash slides two times in 1× wash buffer for 2 minutes at 25°C each time.
Add ∼2–3 drops of AMP4 to cover each section entirely.
Close the tray and insert it into the oven for 15 minutes at 40°C.
Wash slides two times in 1× wash buffer for 2 minutes at 25°C each time.
Add ∼2–3 drops of AMP5 to cover each section entirely.
Incubate for 45 minutes at 25°C.
Wash slides two times in 1× wash buffer for 2 minutes at 25°C each time.
Add ∼2–3 drops of AMP6 to cover each section entirely.
Incubate for 15 minutes at 25°C.
Wash slides two times in 1× wash buffer for 2 minutes at 25°C each time.
Prepare sufficient RED working solution per section by using a 1:60 ratio of Fast RED-B to Fast RED-A (2 μL of Red B to 120 μL of Red A).
Pipette ∼100 μL RED solution onto each tissue section.
Incubate for 10 minutes at 25°C.
Wash twice with Milli Q water.
Immerse slides in 50% Hematoxylin solution for 1 minute at 25°C.
Wash 1 second with Milli Q water.
Wash five times with tap water for 3 minutes each time.
Replace tap water in the staining dish with 0.02% ammonia water, incubate for 1 minute.
Replace ammonia water with Milli Q water, wash slides three to five times.
Dry the slides at 60°C inside the dry oven for at least 15 minutes.
Briefly dip the slide into fresh, pure xylene.
Immediately place 1–2 drops of Eco mount on the slide before the xylene dries.
Place a coverslip over the tissue section.
Gently press with the help of the backside of bent forceps to squeeze out excess eco mount.
Avoid the formation of air bubbles.
Air dry slides for at least 1 h.
Store at 25°C until microscopy.
